title: Even part of the generalized binomial series
statement: For real numbers $s$ and $x$ with $|x|<1$, one has $\frac{(1+x)^s+(1-x)^s}{2}=\sum_{k=0}^{\infty}\binom{s}{2k}x^{2k}$, where $\binom{s}{m}$ denotes the generalized binomial coefficient.
replaced: Let $s,x\in\bbr$ with $|x|<1$, $((1+x)^s+(1-x)^s)/2=\sum_{k=0}^{\infty}\binom{s}{2k}x^{2k}$, using generalized binomial coefficients.
